comment: Scoped npm audit exceptions, matched on the exact (id, package, workspace) tuple. Every entry needs approved_by (not PENDING), approved_on, approval_source, a reason and review_by (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 60 days after approval). Invalid, unapproved or expired entries fail the gate.

entries.reason: No fixed braces release (affected <= 3.0.3, latest 3.0.3; re-checked 2026-10-31). Stack-exhaustion DoS needs attacker-controlled, deeply nested glob patterns. Evidence 2026-10-31: braces/micromatch absent from every shipped artifact — web production image (no node_modules/braces|micromatch|fast-glob|@ducanh2912, 0 references in .next/server.js), dashboard image (absent; dev-only per npm ls --omit=dev), mobile APK v1.0.37 and representative candidate Hermes bundles (0 matches for braces/micromatch/fast-glob signatures; method sanity-checked). Lockfile owners are build/dev tooling only: @ducanh2912/next-pwa + fast-glob (web), tailwindcss/chokidar/eslint (dashboard), expo -> @expo/metro (mobile, representative).
entries.approved_by: Gio (continuation of 2026-10-03 exception; renewed by gio-1c on his behalf)
entries.approval_source: gio-1c to gio-dd 2026-10-31: renewal of Gio's 2026-10-03 risk exception to 2026-12-01, conditional on per-workspace evidence that braces is not in shipped artifacts; Gio informed
